name: fynn-mods
description: Fynn's daily-driver Claude Code mods: an animated mascot, usage-limit bars, a pre-send sidekick, quick replies, a music bar for Spotify (Windows) and a cost ledger.

plugins.name: clawd-buddy
plugins.description: Clawd, an animated pixel mascot above the prompt. He reacts to what Claude is doing and keeps you company while you wait.

plugins.name: limit-bars
plugins.description: Shows your 5-hour and weekly usage limits above the prompt, along with how long the prompt cache stays warm. Asks before a send that would cost more because the cache has gone cold.

plugins.name: sidekick
plugins.description: Checks your message before it is sent and offers a better way where there is one: a new chat with a handoff, a skill, a clearer version or a cheaper model. It never changes your words or sends anything without asking.

plugins.name: quick-replies
plugins.description: Turns Claude Code's suggested next message into a button above the prompt. Click it or type 1 to send it.

plugins.name: tune-strip
plugins.description: Windows only. Shows the song playing in Spotify above the prompt, with cover and playback controls. No login, and nothing leaves your computer.

plugins.name: cost-ledger
plugins.description: Records what every chat costs, across projects and, if you like, across devices, so you can see where your usage goes. It only observes and makes no model calls.
